prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, natural skin texture with pores, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: Su Yaqing, a fictional 27-year-old, Heiress of the Su family, Ji Ran's best friend and Lin Qingyu's older stepsister; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: Strikingly beautiful East Asian heiress in her late twenties who looks young and fresh. Small heart-shaped face with delicate, refined features, large sparkling bright eyes and a small nose. Flawless, luminous, even complexion with no redness and natural texture. Full glamorous make-up: defined brows, fluttery lashes, a glossy pink-nude lip. Glossy chestnut-brown hair falls to mid-back in big bouncy curls. About 171 cm tall with long legs and elegant eight-heads-tall proportions. Curvy figure with full hips, a defined waist and an hourglass shape, and a full C-cup bust. She wears pearl drop earrings and a delicate diamond tennis bracelet.. Wearing one outfit only: At home: a blush-pink satin spaghetti-strap bodycon midi slip dress that hugs her waist and hips, with pink velvet low-heeled mules, pearl drop earrings and a diamond tennis bracelet.. Signature colour: pink. Expression in the close-up shows: Bubbly, teasing and fiercely loyal. She loves gossip and playing matchmaker, and backs Ji Ran whatever she decides.. The full-body views keep the body's build and proportions as the appearance gives them, head-to-body ratio included, never slimmer. Cast as a commercial live-action short drama: an adult lead (the heroine, the hero) or a young adult woman in a prominent role is a strikingly beautiful or handsome, camera-ready actor, with the figure, make-up, hair and fitted outfit the appearance and outfit give; a character under 18 looks and dresses like an ordinary child or teenager of that age and is never styled to look sexy; any other supporting role is an ordinary-looking person of that age.
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 27, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
